entities.name: Agatha, wife of Edward the Exile
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Agatha was married to Edward the Exile, a candidate for the throne of England, and mother of Edgar Ætheling, Saint Margaret of Scotland and Cristina. Her antecedents are unclear and the subject of much speculation.
